spine: 1. C 的 null-terminated 字串把「長度」丟掉，逼所有操作重新算一次或走訪整個字串。
2. snprintf 的回傳值語意本身自相矛盾——輸入含終止符、輸出不含——這個不一致正是「靠終止符表示長度」這個設計的症狀。
3. 每次替字串加內容都要在新的結尾重寫一次終止符，作者以反問點出這是否是白工。
4. null-terminated 字串把「無效字串」拆成 NULL 指標與空字串兩種不同狀態，呼叫端要處理兩套檢查邏輯。
5. 因為依賴終止符判斷結尾，null-terminated 字串無法安全存放內含 \0 的任意二進位資料。
6. 長度變成外顯欄位後，trim / slice / split / tokenize 都能做到零拷貝——作者認為這是替代設計最大的好處。
7. Redis SDS、stretchy buffer、Pascal 式定長字串是三種不同的取捨；作者也承認 null-terminated 字串仍保留 sentinel 前瞻掃描與既有 API 相容性兩個優點。

perspective.mechanism: 用 null-terminated 慣例（以 \0 位元組標記字串結尾）取代顯式長度欄位，是 C 語言在 1970 年代記憶體與效能限制下的設計決定；作者主張這個決定造成一連串下游代價：長度資訊遺失、snprintf 語意分裂、二進位不相容、以及子字串操作必須配置新記憶體。
perspective.tradeoff: 拿掉終止符、改存「指標＋長度」能讓子字串做到零拷貝、二進位安全，但要多付出一個欄位的記憶體與一次跨函式庫的相容性成本；作者也承認 null-terminated 字串保留了 sentinel 前瞻掃描與既有 C API 相容性兩項優點，這是他認為唯一還站得住腳的理由。
perspective.reader_use: 讀者若在寫效能敏感或字串密集的 C/C++ 程式碼（剖析器、文字編輯器、網路協定實作），可以評估是否改用「指標＋長度」的字串型別（如 std::string_view、Rust &str、或本文提出的 struct String）取代裸 char*，尤其在需要重複計算長度或處理二進位資料的場合。

notes.quote: One design choice in C that now feels outdated—and arguably one of its biggest mistakes—is the use of null-terminated strings.
notes.interpretation: 作者用這句話定調全文論點：null-terminated 字串是被時代淘汰、且可能是 C 最大的設計失誤之一。

notes.quote: A string's length is an extremely valuable piece of information. By not storing it, you force all code that uses the string to either repeatedly call strlen or iterate over it byte by byte.
notes.interpretation: 第一個論點：長度資訊遺失，逼所有下游程式碼重複計算長度。

notes.quote: the input integer includes the null terminator, while the output integer excludes it.
notes.interpretation: snprintf 的輸入輸出整數語意不對稱，是長度靠終止符表示這件事的具體症狀。

notes.quote: You're probably thinking: wait, doesn't this mean you're constantly overwriting the previous null terminator? In other words, aren't all those intermediate terminators unnecessary?
notes.interpretation: 作者以反問句提出：每次擴充字串都要重寫終止符，暗示這可能是重複性的工作，但這段本身未直接斷言代價大小，只是提問。

notes.quote: having two different meanings for a string's length also gives you two distinct representations of an invalid string: an empty string and a null string.
notes.interpretation: null-terminated 字串把無效狀態拆成 NULL 指標與空字串兩種，呼叫端要分開處理。

notes.quote: Since all code now operates on an explicit length rather than relying on a null terminator, the type can safely store arbitrary binary data, including values that contain null bytes.
notes.interpretation: 改成外顯長度欄位後，型別可以安全存放內含 \0 的任意二進位資料。

notes.quote: By requiring every string to end with a null terminator, you force all common string operations—such as trimming, slicing, splitting, tokenizing, and searching—to allocate new strings.
notes.interpretation: null-terminated 慣例逼所有常見字串操作配置新記憶體，無法做到零拷貝。

notes.quote: And finally, perhaps the most important advantage of all: efficient substrings. This is by far the greatest advantage
notes.interpretation: 作者認為零拷貝子字串是採用 length-based 設計最大的好處，用詞從『perhaps』升級到『by far the greatest』，屬於作者自己在同一段內的語氣升級。
作者提出的具體 length-based 字串型別定義與輔助巨集，逐字照抄用於文中與 widget。

notes.quote: Redis does not use C strings antirez wrote a custom string library called SDS: Simple Dynamic Strings it later became a standalone library C strings had three problems Redis could not accept - strlen is O(n) because it scans until the null terminator
notes.interpretation: 文章嵌入一則推文（署名 @TrisH0x2A），指出 Redis 自行開發 SDS 取代 C 字串，原因之一是 strlen 的 O(n) 掃描成本；推文本身提到「三個問題」，但兩次擷取都只完整呈現第一個問題，其餘在讀到的版本中被截斷，故本文只引用可核實的部分，不臆測另外兩個問題的內容。

notes.quote: It "colors" every char* with something mostly invisible.
notes.interpretation: 作者對 stretchy buffer 的保留：capacity/length 放在資料前面的隱藏 header，讓每個 char* 帶著一種不透明的隱藏語意。

notes.quote: Storing an extra capacity field, while understandable for a dynamic array, is a poor design choice for strings.
notes.interpretation: 作者明確評價：capacity 欄位對動態陣列合理，對字串是不好的設計選擇。

notes.quote: Pascal-style strings, or short strings, as the name suggests, store strings in a fixed-size character array, typically 256 bytes in size.
notes.interpretation: Pascal 式定長字串的具體定義：固定大小字元陣列，通常 256 bytes。

notes.quote: This approach may have made sense in the past, when there were real memory and hardware constraints. Nowadays, with a good memory allocation strategy, it doesn't make any sense except in very specific contexts.
notes.interpretation: 作者對 Pascal 式定長字串的歷史評價：過去合理，現在除非特定場合否則不合理。

notes.quote: With a sentinel, null-terminated strings can safely check the current byte in a loop at any time. Even better, they can perform lookaheads and check for sequences of bytes, with the guarantee that order is preserved, allowing short-circuit evaluation to fail early.
notes.interpretation: 作者承認的第一個優點：sentinel 讓前瞻掃描安全，且能靠循序保證做短路提前失敗。

notes.quote: since C uses null-terminated strings, most popular libraries and OS APIs require them. This is true, but it is usually not that significant in practice—especially on Windows, where you already have to convert UTF-8 strings to UTF-16.
notes.interpretation: 作者承認的第二個優點：既有 API 相容性，但認為實務衝擊不大，並舉 Windows UTF-8/UTF-16 轉換為例。

notes.quote: this outdated design choice may have made more sense in the 1970s due to the memory and performance constraints of the time
notes.interpretation: 作者對整個 null-terminated 設計的歷史定位：可能在 1970 年代的軟硬體限制下比較合理，用詞是 may have made more sense，屬於明確的 hedge。

claims.evidence: this outdated design choice may have made more sense in the 1970s due to the memory and performance constraints of the time
